question: Where do exploratory high-power episodes begin, and do the observed associations survive period and repeated-profile checks?
scope: 2021-01-01 through 2021-08-31, valid hours 0 through 23; retain zero power and production
high_definition: Maximum of the four within-record power values >= 182; threshold inherited from EDA 003 and 008, selected from Jan-Jun training period
onset_definition: High target record with exactly one-hour-earlier observed peak < 182; records without a previous valid hour are ineligible
episode_definition: Contiguous high records at exact hourly spacing; a gap starts a left-censored episode
result_driven_followup: After the first run showed different previous-zero and target-zero onset counts, count all four previous-to-target production states with their eligible denominators; this is posthoc and is not an advance warning feature
profile_sensitivity: Within each period weight every eligible hour by reciprocal of the number of dates sharing its exact 96-value daily power profile; no dates deleted
decision: Report denominators, episodes, period and profile sensitivity. Do not infer causes, an alarm rule, saved energy, or effects of shifting production. Stop if no new actionable condition is supported.
